test_case.test_name: Post-boot AGFHC recipe qualification with owner-selected cycle scope — GATE-CLOSED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After scope resolution, prove that the exact approved post-boot state initializes the complete GPU stack and the selected AGFHC recipe completes without Failed results or new platform errors, either once after an external boot or across the explicitly owned bounded reboot sequence.
required_package: Signed choice: recipe-only after external boot, or row-owned bounded reboot cycles
Exact AGFHC project/recipe/version/checksum and success/Failed semantics
Boot identity, readiness, stabilization, GPU enumeration and service oracle
If row-owned: cycle count/order, controller, timeout, console recovery and no-retry policy
Kernel/RAS/BMC/GPU error policy, dedicated authorization and evidence storage
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED — DO NOT EXECUTE until scope is selected. Recipe-only branch: bind the externally completed boot ID/readiness and run the exact recipe once. Cycle-owning branch: after approval issue each bounded reboot once, prove console/boot/service/GPU readiness and stabilization, then run the exact recipe at the approved position. In either branch retain complete command/output/exit/generated files and pre/post health deltas. Stop on boot, GPU, recipe, controller or health anomaly; never clear, substitute recipe or retry.
test_case.expected_result: After unlock, every approved boot context reaches complete readiness and the exact recipe completes with its approved success state, no Failed result, full intended GPU enumeration and no new disallowed kernel/RAS/BMC/platform fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible until the recipe-only versus row-owned-cycle scope is signed. Then PASS requires every required boot context, exact recipe and complete artifact/health criteria. FAIL on missing readiness/GPU, Failed/unknown recipe state, incomplete cycle, new disallowed error or evidence gap. Help output or truncated health snippets cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until scope, recipe and boot contract are signed.
Reboot, if owned, requires workload drain, bounded count, explicit approval and independent recovery.
Preserve full per-boot and recipe evidence; do not clear logs or rely on snippets.
Stop at first anomaly and do not retry or escalate recipe/cycle count.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed scope disposition
Baseline boot ID, GPU/service/kernel/RAS/BMC state and authorization
Per-required-context boot milestones and complete AGFHC output/exit/generated artifacts
Full identity-bound GPU and system error delta analysis
No-clear/no-substitution/no-retry audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On boot/readiness, controller, GPU, recipe or health failure, stop and preserve the first-failure context. Do not reboot or rerun the recipe automatically. Use only the approved console/controller recovery, quarantine uncertain state and require owner disposition.
